dogecoin.text: Since Trump’s inauguration, the performance of top cryptocurrencies like $BTC, $ETH, $XRP, $BNB, $SOL, $ADA, $TRX, $DOGE, $TON, and $SUI has been mixed—some have surged to new highs, while others have declined, reflecting changing market sentiment and political influence. https://t.co/0zASFH3jlh

In the past 24 hours, over $793M in crypto shorts were liquidated, signaling market shakeout. $BTC led the charge with $220M in liquidations, followed by $ETH at $160M. Altcoins like $SOL $DOGE $ $PEPE also saw sharp squeezes, as bullish momentum caught bearish traders off guard
